# Google Shopping query price snapshot for AI ecommerce agents (toninovo/google-shopping-price-intelligence)

When to use: A one-time Google Shopping product-query price snapshot for ecommerce market research, AI shopping assistants, and a min/median/max summary computed over returned rows.
When not to use: verified merchant product links, precise SKU matching, stock, shipping, checkout, price history.
Small paid example input: {"queries":["wireless earbuds"],"country":"us","language":"en","limit":10,"maxAttempts":2}.
An agent must check the live price and have authorization before paying. Avoid duplicate paid calls just to test visibility.
Installable agent skill: https://github.com/toninovo4249-ai/google-shopping-price-intelligence-docs/blob/main/skills/google-shopping-price-snapshot/SKILL.md
Agent entry point: https://github.com/toninovo4249-ai/google-shopping-price-intelligence-docs/blob/main/AGENTS.md
Payment choices and limitations: https://github.com/toninovo4249-ai/google-shopping-price-intelligence-docs/blob/main/AGENT_PAYMENT.md
Apify x402 is an optional official prepaid-token path, not a verified successful wallet-funded run of this Actor.
Docs repository: https://github.com/toninovo4249-ai/google-shopping-price-intelligence-docs
Actor: https://apify.com/toninovo/google-shopping-price-intelligence
Store markdown: https://apify.com/toninovo/google-shopping-price-intelligence.md
Default build: 0.2.12.
Price: 0.003 USD per delivered product-result, billed by Apify. No separate payment gateway is documented here.
Agent wallet checkout: not verified.
Input: queries (required, 1-10 strings), country (default us), language (default en), limit (1-55, default 55), maxAttempts (1-4, default 4).
Free Apify users: 1 query, limit 10, maxAttempts 2.
Output fields a default run can return: query, country, language, rank, title, priceText, priceNumeric, currency, merchant, rating, reviewCount, imageUrl, link, queryProductCount, queryMerchantCount, queryMinPrice, queryMedianPrice, queryMaxPrice, queryPriceSpreadPct, attemptCount, queriedAt.
link is a Google Shopping search reference. A production sample stored a google.com/search URL there. It is not a verified merchant product offer URL.
Do not expect merchantOfferUrl, searchReferenceUrl, or provenanceStatus on the default build.
Not for: product-page monitoring, stock, price history, checkout.
MCP: fetch-actor-details with slug toninovo/google-shopping-price-intelligence. search-actors may omit this Actor. call-actor spends money.
Run API: POST /v2/acts/toninovo~google-shopping-price-intelligence/runs
Dataset: GET /v2/datasets/{defaultDatasetId}/items
Python: https://github.com/toninovo4249-ai/google-shopping-price-intelligence-docs/blob/main/examples/run_snapshot.py
JavaScript: https://github.com/toninovo4249-ai/google-shopping-price-intelligence-docs/blob/main/examples/run_snapshot.mjs
Tutorial: https://github.com/toninovo4249-ai/google-shopping-price-intelligence-docs/blob/main/TUTORIAL.md
Example task, compare competitor laptop prices, input laptop 16GB RAM, us, en, limit 20: https://apify.com/toninovo/google-shopping-price-intelligence/tasks/compare-laptop-prices
Example task, ecommerce market price research for wireless earbuds, input wireless earbuds, us, en, limit 20: https://apify.com/toninovo/google-shopping-price-intelligence/tasks/wireless-earbuds-market-price
Example task, compare espresso machine competitor prices, input espresso machine, us, en, limit 20: https://apify.com/toninovo/google-shopping-price-intelligence/tasks/espresso-competitor-prices
